recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision changes the Bundle-to-CDA mapping.
issue_request: FHIR-17072 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Feed/Bundle change request asking to include CDA mappings because parts of Bundle map to the CDA header.
initial_application: The Jira application comment records svn 14370. The matching git-svn commit 4831444f506101bc952bb456633a00d48ee3d7fd, "GF#17072 - mappings to CDA", added CDA mappings to the Bundle spreadsheet for Bundle, Bundle.identifier, and Bundle.timestamp; later source refactors preserved these in structuredefinition-Bundle.xml.
additional_context: Bundle is an active current-build resource and normative infrastructure resource. Exact Zulip and Confluence searches found no FHIR-17072 community records; broader CDA/Bundle hits did not reveal a later reversal or conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml declares the CDA mapping space and maps Bundle to ClinicalDocument when bundle.type is document, Bundle.identifier to ClinicalDocument.id, and Bundle.timestamp to ClinicalDocument.effectiveTime; build.fhir.org renders the same CDA mapping table.
